ai1.title: Which parameter combinations can a readout identify?
bullets: A limiting curve at fixed dimensionless time loses the physical parameter information.
The declared physical-time surrogate identifies one combined slow rate. A continuously observed, calibrated carrier can conditionally identify the electric scale as well.
Exact parameter fibers, discrete carrier aliases and a value-error counterexample prevent promoting that classification to an actual finite-profile inverse.

ai2.title: Two physical Wilson probes separate a frozen pair
bullets: Two actual coherent Wilson multiplication observables share a ten-link seed. Their complete collar counts and all scalar error terms are recomputed.

Of nine predeclared settings, only u = 10^-18 and collar depth 5 separates the two hypotheses using complete response disks. Both probes succeed there; all simple-ratio comparisons remain insufficient.
The common time is 2 × 10^48 hbar/alpha. This is a mathematical pairwise certificate, without a practical instrument or continuous parameter reconstruction.

ag1.title: One complete nonlinear correction of the selected source
bullets: The full conjugation of G+A retains the filtered residual and every nonlinear term. The proof preserves the operator domain and pays support-weight loss at each commutator.

For M <= 10^-3, the entire nonlinear remainder has a bound uniform over containing finite cuboids. For M <= 10^-4, the generated remainder and its extracted mixing source have norm below two-thirds of the actual input norm.

The contraction uses the actual homogeneous source norm and complete supports. Scalar and diagonal changes remain explicit; transport of any other original remainder is conditional on its own bound. No second correction or all-stage iteration is established.

equations.label: Same-norm one-step bound, M <= 10^-4
equations.expression: ||R+N||_2 < (2/3)||A||_2, for nonzero selected input; zero input has zero update
